description: Blocked integral P_gamma(z, p) = integral of (1 - r^2)^gamma over the occulted part of the unit stellar disk (no normalisation; P = pi p^2 D). Independent reference: tanh-sinh quadrature of the area integral (pizzetti/validation/refcheck.py). 'double': P_fast, ~1e-16 relative. 'mp30': P_mp with 30 digits, as strings.
